Interface Light

All Known Implementing Classes:
AreaLight, BioluminescentLight, BlackHoleLight, FractalLight, MuratAmbientLight, MuratDirectionalLight, MuratPointLight, ProjectorLight, PulsatingPointLight, SphereLight, SpotLight, TubeLight
public interface Light
Represents a light source within the ray tracer. Optimized to eliminate object allocation by using packed integer ARGB colors. Compatible with Java 6-8 without lambdas.

Animation support: - Position animation via delta values (x, y, z) - Color animation via delta values (alpha, red, green, blue) - Two-phase animation (increase then decrease)

    • setColorDelta

      void setColorDelta(int[] delta)
      Sets color animation delta values. First half: color channels increase by these values each frame. Second half: color channels decrease by these values each frame. All delta values are automatically clamped to 0-255 range during update.
      Parameters:
      delta - Array of four ints: {alpha_delta, red_delta, green_delta, blue_delta}

    • getColorDelta

      int[] getColorDelta()
